reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 15 unrelated states (diverged seed 0 resolves to 'merge'); a precondition set that accepts unrelated states is a defect. refused_program.body:
git merge --no-edit -X ours {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} || true
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null; then
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    if git cat-file -e ":2:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      git checkout --ours -- "$f"
      git add -- "$f"
    else
      git rm -q -f -- "$f"
    fi
  done < <(git ls-files -u -z | tr '\0' '\n' | cut -f2- | sort -u)
  git commit --no-edit
fi
refused_program.intent: Merge the upstream branch into the current branch so the branch is up to date, and settle the dependency-file conflict in favor of the local side so what was removed locally stays removed.

postconditions.description: for every path the local branch changed since the merge base, the lines it removed are absent from the merged tree
postconditions.name: locally_removed_lines_stay_removed
postconditions.probe:
git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD^2 >/dev/null || exit 1
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  git diff --quiet "$base" HEAD^1 -- "$p" && continue
  git cat-file -e "HEAD:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
    if git show "HEAD:$p" | grep -qxF -- "$line"; then
      echo "locally removed line is back in $p: $line"
      exit 1
    fi
  done < <(git diff --unified=0 "$base" HEAD^1 -- "$p" | grep '^-' | grep -v '^---' | sed 's/^-//')
done < <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n')
exit 0

  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .
